tools.name: search_comedy_specials
tools.description: Find a special by keywords in its title, description, comedian name or related track titles; optionally filter by a returned comedianId, exact year or yearFrom/yearTo range. When discovery is enabled, topicSlug/styleSlug from list_comedy_topics compose with these filters and select transcript-review

tools.description: Find individual tracks by literal keywords in track/special titles or comedian names, optionally within a returned specialId or comedianId. tools.name: get_comedy_track
tools.description: Read a track using a returned trackId. Includes parent special, reported audio readiness and canonical listening/transcript links. Playback access remains website-owned; readiness is not proof of successful delivery or complete original release.

tools.name: list_comedy_topics
tools.description: Find the catalog's canonical SUBJECT topics and STYLE categories, including aliases and scoped counts of transcript-reviewed specials. Search an interest such as dating to resolve its canonical slug, then pass topicSlug/styleSlug to search_comedy_specials. Coverage is partial: a topic describes mate

tools.name: search_comedy_channels
tools.description: Search public, non-deprecated channel titles/descriptions or browse with no query. Returns bounded alphabetical pages and canonical channel links. Channels are within this server's explicit scope. Open a returned channelId to browse its videos.

tools.name: get_comedy_channel
tools.description: Read a returned channelId and a bounded newest-first page of its catalog videos. Continue with nextOffset. Includes website links; no media URLs or private import/administration fields.

tools.name: search_comedy_videos
tools.description: Find videos by literal keywords in video title/description or channel title, optionally in a returned channelId and/or with a ready transcript. tools.name: get_comedy_video
tools.description: Read a returned videoId for title, description, channel, published date, duration, reported availability and website/transcript links. No provider tokens, download URLs, administrative errors or transcript body are returned by this metadata tool.

tools.name: get_comedy_transcript
tools.description: Read at most 4000 characters of a READY public transcript for a returned track, special or enabled video ID.
